other_failure_modes.name: Unaligned Categorical Data Types
other_failure_modes.description: When converting columns to pandas 'category' dtype independently for train and test sets, the underlying integer mapping can differ between the sets if the test set contains missing or new categories. This causes tree-based models like LightGBM to misinterpret category values at prediction time.

summary: The solution establishes a valid training pipeline using LightGBM with early stopping but lacks data cleaning and feature engineering entirely. It suffers from a critical data processing flaw where categorical columns are independently cast to 'category' types in train and test, which will likely misalign integer codes and break predictions. Additionally, it relies on a single stochastic evaluation point without estimating variance.
